paper_title: Capacitated Sum-Of-Radii Clustering: An FPT Approximation
classifications: Theory of computation → Facility location and clustering
statement: We obtain constant approximations for the uniform capacitated sum of radii problem in FPT time. It is unclear whether a similar result can be obtained in polynomial time. Finally, obtaining a constant approximation for the matroid version of the problem in polynomial time remains open.
